title: THREE LANES
description: The claim in condensed display type, then a six-year record in three lanes, phone, web and server, newest first: real screens sit in the lane they run in, under a red Today line. Offday fills all three lanes in the first row.
signature: Big Shoulders Display for the claim, years and lane headers; Libre Franklin text; Martian Mono facts. Warm paper and ink with one red, the calendars' today line. The year bars draw down once when the record enters view (600 ms expo-out, 25 ms stagger).
rule: the page is a six-year record in three lanes, phone, web and server; every product sits in the lane it runs in and the year it shipped, so the lanes fill in from phone to web to server
designRead: Reading this as: a phone-and-web developer who moved to full stack, for a hiring manager on a phone, leading with Offday (one product in all three lanes), in a dated record of three lanes.
hook: The site where his work is laid out in three lanes, phone, web and server, and the server lane is empty until 2026.
lead: Offday, 2026: the only product that runs in all three lanes at once, so the first row is the claim drawn as a picture; it is the owner's own full-stack product, and the other drafts lead with the care platform, Bayyinah TV and the store apps. The care platform rebuild and its API are the second row.
composition: 3 (the claim drawn as a picture: three lanes are the sentence) crossed with 4 (a dated record, years down the page).
